summary: Alpine Income Property Trust, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to update an existing at-the-market equity distribution program, adding new sales agents and forward sellers (AGP, Cantor, Colliers, Huntington, Lucid, UBS) and amending prior agreements. As of the filing, shares with an aggregate offering price of up to $46,468,856.85 remain available. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special situation such as a tender offer, acquisition, or restructuring. No terms of a specific deal are stated; the filing merely expands distribution channels for an ongoing ATM program.
